canonical_source_provenance.detail: The canonical 103-function count and the 14 missing names come entirely from prior committed owner-audit evidence (plans/investigations/owner_audit/{acceptance_runner,defect_gate_map}). That evidence's canonical source was an operator-supplied upload (readme-refresh-complete-bundle-20260819-174412.zip, sha256 2d8eb6ae810d920b98136f3fa587b46d36b2e0c6b5250df109fa98c73e470465, per SOURCE_INVENTORY.json), not a file committed to this git repository. This audit could not independently re-download or re-count the canonical bundle (read-only, no network fetch performed); it instead verified that the optimizer side of that comparison is UNCHANGED since it was taken: src/readme_agent/vendored_asposeorg/scripts/pipeline/commands/foss/readme_refresh_checks.py is byte-identical between commit d71f38b6a050b5282f0ada314f9ee4de35950426 (the prior audit's optimizer pin) and aa998102191c530af4dca3a6895d62a4027a613e (this audit's pin) -- git diff --stat is empty, and AST extraction at HEAD independently confirms exactly 89 top-level check_* functions, matching the prior audit's count exactly. The 103/14 canonical figures are therefore still applicable, but remain second-hand evidence, not independently re-derived from canonical source text in this pass.
